name: message-router

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ai/20261030-routing-goal
    paths:
      - "messages/**"
      - ".github/scripts/message_router.py"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: message-router-${{ github.ref }}
  queue: max

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  route:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate envelopes and rebuild message status
        run: python3 .github/scripts/message_router.py
      - name: Commit status updates
        if: always()
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add messages/status MUSE_STATUS.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "no status changes"
          else
            git commit -m "message-router: 状態一覧を更新"
            git push
          fi
